## Required Packages

```{r}
library(xcms)
library(MSnbase)
library(BiocParallel)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
gf_lima_meta <- read.csv(params$metadata_file)
```


## Data loading

```{r}
quant_files <- list.files(path = params$file_dir, full.names = TRUE)
file_names <- quant_files[sub(pattern = "\\.[mM][zZ][xX]?[mM][lL]$", replacement = "", 
                              x = basename(quant_files)) %in% gf_lima_meta$injection_order]
findOrder <- function(files, phenodata, pheno_var){
    samp <- sub(pattern = "\\.[mM][zZ][xX]?[mM][lL]$", replacement = "",
                x =  basename(files))
    if(length(pheno_var) == 1){
        if(pheno_var == "rownames"){
            ordering <- rownames(phenodata)
        } else{
            ordering <- phenodata[[pheno_var]]
        }
    } else{
        ordering <- pheno_var
    }
    if(!all(ordering %in% samp)){
        stop("Filenames do not agree with the phenodata variable. Change the names accordingly")
    }
    return(order(sapply(samp, function(x){which(ordering == x)})))
}
file_order <- findOrder(file_names, phenodata = gf_lima_meta, pheno_var = "injection_order")
quant_files <- file_names[file_order]
```


```{r}
ms_data <- readMSData(files = quant_files, pdata = AnnotatedDataFrame(data = gf_lima_meta), centroided. = TRUE, mode = "onDisk")
ms_data <- filterEmptySpectra(ms_data)
```

```{r}
BiocParallel::register(SerialParam())
# register(SnowParam())
ms_data <- findChromPeaks(ms_data, param = CentWaveParam(ppm = 10, peakwidth = c(5, 50)))

peak_path <- paste0(params$output_dir,"xcmsnexp_chrom_peaks.rds")
if(!file.exists(peak_path)){
    ms_data <- refineChromPeaks(ms_data, param = MergeNeighboringPeaksParam())
    ms_data <- adjustRtime(ms_data, param = ObiwarpParam())
    
    saveRDS(ms_data, peak_path)    
} else{
    ms_data <- readRDS(peak_path)
}

```

```{r}
# ms_data <- readRDS(paste0(params$output_dir,"xcmsnexp_chrom_rt_corrected.rds"))

filled_xcmsnexp_path <- paste0(params$output_dir, "xcmsnexp_filled.rds")
summ_exp_path <- paste0(params$output_dir, "summarized.rds")
if(!file.exists(filled_xcmsnexp_path)){
    pdp <- PeakDensityParam(sampleGroups = gf_lima_meta$groups_m,
                        minFraction = 0.4, bw = 5, binSize = 0.01)
    ms_data <- groupChromPeaks(ms_data, param = pdp)
    ms_data <- fillChromPeaks(ms_data, param = FillChromPeaksParam())
    saveRDS(ms_data, file = filled_xcmsnexp_path)
    saveRDS(quantify(ms_data, value = "into"), file =  summ_exp_path)
} else{
    ms_data <- readRDS(filled_xcmsnexp_path)
}
```

```{r}
library(qHermes)
library(xcms)
hermes_dt <- readRDS(paste0(params$output_dir,"filteredSoiLists.rds"))
ms_data <- qHermes::annotateFeaturesFromList(XCMSnExp = ms_data, RHermesExp = hermes_dt, 
                                             SOI_id = 4, filter = FALSE)
xcms_dt <- quantify(ms_data, value = "into")
saveRDS(xcms_dt, file =  paste0(params$output_dir, "summarized_hermes_xcms.rds"))
```
